description: ZZZNFTMetadata._visualAttributes(NFTMetadataInput).number (src/ZZZNFTMetadata.sol#107) is a local variable never initialized
location: ZZZNFTMetadata._visualAttributes(NFTMetadataInput).number (src/ZZZNFTMetadata.sol#107) is a local variable never initialized
rationale: Solidity initializes the uint256 local number to zero. The only use is prefix ++number for a Color N JSON label, inside the bounded eight-bit palette loop after a set-bit test. The immutable catalogue has one to three set bits, so the renderer labels Color 1, Color 2 and Color 3 as applicable. The counter is not a price, custody amount, storage index or randomness input. The revealed branch is gated by traitsReady; unrevealed metadata returns before it. Current source was read and decoded metadata tests cover these labels.
remaining_release_gate: Production immutable asset/CID publication must match all canonical palette/pattern/state filenames; independent current-source review and real VRF integration remain required.
secondary_internal_review: Contract implementation agent independently confirmed default-zero/prefix-increment semantics and the counter-only JSON label use.

location: ZZZArtwork.slitherConstructorConstantVariables() (src/libraries/ZZZArtwork.sol#9-30) uses literals with too many digits:
rationale: The RARE literal is a fixed byte table containing 300 big-endian uint16 visual inventory entries, not a numeric price, economic percentage or arithmetic precision constant. Every entry is paletteIndex * 4 + patternIndex, bounded below 232. The complete emitted bytes and SHA-256 agree with the canonical packed JSON; cross-language tests decode all 1,000 entries, verify exact quotas and enforce the full-artwork duplicate caps. Breaking a byte literal into decimal units or adding numeric separators would not improve these visual data semantics. Production selection still requires authenticated ordered VRF draws without replacement.
remaining_release_gate: Generated source, canonical inventory, complete immutable asset publication and actual selected-chain VRF configuration must be reviewed together before deployment; independent audit remains required.
secondary_internal_review: Contract implementation agent independently confirmed the 600-byte table and uint16 entry interpretation.
